issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 vocab issue asking to clarify the CodeSystem $compose/$find-matches exact input parameter: exact=true means machine use returning complete and partial matches but not possible matches, exact=false means human use allowing possible matches, and the default should be stated.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 14664, represented in git by 1709669f6e8cac1c0a4e74655049d57d1d820468. That commit changed source/codesystem/codesystem-spreadsheet.xml so the exact parameter documentation distinguished human false from machine true, excluded possible matches for machine use, and stated default false. Later source splitting into operationdefinition-CodeSystem-find-matches.xml preserved that parameter documentation but retained the older top-level description sentence, so historical application was mixed.
additional_context: CodeSystem is still active in source/fhir.ini, but source/codesystem/list-CodeSystem-operations.xml currently references only CodeSystem-lookup, CodeSystem-validate-code, and CodeSystem-subsumes. Commit 40306e5cd9c1b1e3eb6f115de16a8da3aa13a351 removed operationdefinition-CodeSystem-find-matches.xml and the active operation-list reference as part of the R6 terminology infrastructure cleanup. Current source still has orphan find-matches request/response text files, but they are not referenced by the active CodeSystem operation list.
